description: This source file defines a custom assertion class 'PolicyAssert' for testing 'Policy' objects in Java projects. It provides various methods to assert properties of policy objects, such as ID, namespace, labels, subjects, resources, lifecycle, revision, and modification status, primarily used for testing purposes.

classes.name: PolicyAssert
classes.description: A custom assertion class extending AssertJ's AbstractAssert to facilitate unit testing of Policy objects by providing domain-specific assertion methods.

methods.name: PolicyAssert
methods.description: Constructor initializing the assertion with the actual Policy object.

methods.name: hasId
methods.description: Asserts that the Policy has the expected identifier.

methods.name: hasNamespace
methods.description: Asserts that the Policy's namespace matches the expected value.

methods.name: hasLabel
methods.description: Asserts that the Policy contains a specific label.

methods.name: doesNotHaveLabel
methods.description: Asserts that the Policy does not contain a specific label.

methods.name: hasSubjectFor
methods.description: Asserts that a specific subject exists for a given label in the Policy.

methods.name: doesNotHaveSubjectFor
methods.description: Asserts that a specific subject does not exist for a given label.

methods.name: hasSubjectTypeFor
methods.description: Asserts that the subject associated with a label has the expected SubjectType.

methods.name: hasResourceFor
methods.description: Asserts that a resource of specified type and path exists within the label in the Policy.

methods.name: doesNotHaveResourceFor
methods.description: Asserts that a resource of specified type and path does not exist within the label.

methods.name: hasResourceEffectedPermissionsFor
methods.description: Asserts that the resource has the expected EffectedPermissions.

methods.name: hasLifecycle
methods.description: Asserts that the Policy has the specified lifecycle.

methods.name: hasNoLifecycle
methods.description: Asserts that the Policy does not have a lifecycle set.

methods.name: hasRevision
methods.description: Asserts that the Policy has the expected revision.

methods.name: hasNoRevision
methods.description: Asserts that the Policy has no revision.

methods.name: hasModified
methods.description: Asserts that the Policy's modified timestamp matches the expected value.

methods.name: hasNoModified
methods.description: Asserts that the Policy has no modified timestamp.

methods.name: isModifiedAfter
methods.description: Asserts that the Policy was modified after the specified Instant.

methods.name: isNotModifiedAfter
methods.description: Asserts that the Policy was modified before the specified Instant.

methods.name: isEqualEqualToButModified
methods.description: Asserts that the actual Policy equals the expected one in entityId and entries, and has the same modification timestamp.
